description.value: Russell Brewing Company is a Richmond-based craft brewery that has been producing beer since 1995, making it one of BC's longer-running independent craft operations. Their lineup spans styles from a citrusy Pale Ale and hop-forward Punch Bowl IPA to a traditionally malt-forward Angry Scotch Ale. Whether or not the facility has a public taproom, their beers are widely distributed to retailers across the region.
